title: Arbitration — Chapter 173 (REPLACEMENT)
text:
LAWS OF BRUNEI
Arbitration CAP. 173 1
The Arbitration Act (Chapter 173) was repealed by
the Arbitration Order, 2009 (S 34/2009)
with effect from 23rd February 2010*
* The notification of commencement made under section 1(1) of the Arbitration Order, 2009 was published in
No. S 18 of 2010
B.L.R.O. 1/2016
